visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The camera pans rightward across a counter display of Pilot fountain pens in a stationery store. Each pen is housed in a specific black-and-gold holder with white labels above indicating nib grades like SF, SM, and BB. The indoor lighting is bright and even, highlighting the glossy black finish and gold bands of the pens. (2) A person's hand enters the frame from the right, reaching for a specific pen in the display. The hand grasps the pen firmly and lifts it out of its cradle, revealing the gold-colored nib as it prepares to write. The setting remains the stationery shop counter with multiple product options visible in the background. (3) The scene shifts to an extreme close-up of a white gridded testing pad. The Pilot brand logo is printed at the top of the page. The hand holds the fountain pen and begins writing intricate Japanese characters with black ink. The camera remains steady, focusing on the smooth movement of the nib across the paper surface. (4) The writing continues as the person writes 'Men's Game' in elegant cursive English, followed by a signature 'Alan L.' The ink appears rich and consistent against the simple grid of the paper, emphasizing the clarity and precision of the pen's performance.
